title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - InterconnectionPointIdentifier
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/InterconnectionPointIdentifier. Interconnection Point Identifier is a unique Service Access Point that identifies the location where resources can interconnect.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'InterconnectionPointIdentifier'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

ipiType.description: Property. Type of the interconnection point identifier. Controlled-vocabulary value: IPIType per the source ontology (enumeration not resolved in this pass).

ipiProvider.description: Property. The Provider of the IPI.

specificParameters.description: Property. Type or Provider Specific Parameters, separated by colons.

completeIPI.description: Property. Unique label identifying structure of an IPI, serialized as '{ipiType}:{ipiProvider}:{specificParameters}'.

datacenterAllocation.description: Relationship. Details regarding the specific datacenter location where service access occurs. Links to a DatacenterAllocation entity.

macAddress.description: Property. The MAC address required for L2 connectivity setup.

ipAddress.description: Property. The IP address required for L3 connectivity setup.
